name: branch
description: List the branches in the repository, most recently committed to first, with the checked-out one marked. Use to find out what work is in flight, or to check whether a branch already exists before creating it. This only lists: switching or creating a branch is git/checkout.

remote.description: Include remote-tracking branches (origin/...) as well as local ones.

max_branches.description: Maximum number of branches to list. The output says so when it truncates. They are sorted by last commit, so the cap drops the stalest.

output_schema.description: One branch per line: "* " for the checked-out branch and "  " for the rest, then the name, the date of its last commit, and that commit's subject. Sorted newest first. A repository with no commits yet is the single line "[git/branch] no branches yet" and still succeeds.

exit_codes.0: success (the branches are on stdout, including when there are none)
exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is the wrong type)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the git repository is above the workspace root)
exit_codes.5: no repository (the workspace is not a git repository, or git is not installed)
